function pick({hashtags}){if(!Array.isArray(hashtags)||!hashtags.length||hashtags.some(x=>typeof x!=='string'||!/^#[\p{L}\p{N}_]+$/u.test(x)||Array.from(x).length>80))throw Error('Configure at least one valid hashtag');const hashtag=hashtags[Math.floor(Math.random()*hashtags.length)];return{hashtag}}

return [{json:pick({hashtags:['#techtwitter','#n8n']})}];

function validate({hashtag,text}){if(typeof hashtag!=='string'||typeof text!=='string')throw Error('Invalid draft');const content=text.trim();let found=false,offset=0;while(offset<content.length){const i=content.indexOf(hashtag,offset);if(i<0)break;const next=Array.from(content.slice(i+hashtag.length))[0]||'';if(!/[\p{L}\p{N}_]/u.test(next)){found=true;break}offset=i+hashtag.length}if(!content||Array.from(content).length>=100||!found)throw Error('Draft must include the selected hashtag and be under 100 characters');return{hashtag,content,records:[{fields:{Hashtag:hashtag,Content:content}}]}}

const result=$input.first().json;if(result.finish_reason==='length')throw Error('Draft was truncated');const r=validate({hashtag:$('Choose a hashtag').first().json.hashtag,text:result.message?.content});return [{json:{Hashtag:r.hashtag,Content:r.content}}];
